\item[] Wall-clock time is the column \texttt{wall} of \file{sim/results/<program>/<task>/seed<s>.csv} at the last evaluation (seconds since launch, evaluations included); for GRPO, it is the last \texttt{wall} of the training steps of \file{sim/llm/results/<model>/mul2/<reward>/seed<s>.jsonl}. The PPO and TRPO models actually count 1,024,000 steps (blocks of 51,200). The reconstructed register \file{sim/logs/attempts\_reconstructed.csv} counts 292 launches for the training runs of the grid, of B1 and of the E6 diagnosis, 250 of them successful.
